mostWorthwhile.text: Wrapping the air sacs in capillaries was most worthwhile: the close contact and thin barrier made the exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding elastic support was less informative: the result showed where the fibres went but did not explain their role.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the airway-to-sac connections could not be added directly to the supported sacs; they first had to join the larger airways.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting the finished lungs to the circulation made me curious about how fresh air reaches the sacs during breathing.
